additionalDocuments.label: Wynwood · original factsheet, Mitchell’s broker mirror

review.imagery: 59 gallery entries include 10 dated site photographs. All 22 primary assets, the full 72-page brochure index, 36 native resources and ten September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. Two exact primary repeats, native colour panels and redundant scene crops were excluded. Twenty-nine brochure scenes add lobby, garden, gym, balcony, study, duplex and bathroom views. The full daylight frontage supplies card and hero. Original pixels and historical photograph dates remain intact.
review.floorPlans: All seventeen original physical sheets 2–18 were visually reviewed on five contacts. Floors 7–14 show separate duplex portions. No whole-home area was assigned to a level portion. The packet skips the first podium. Three openly displayed broker 1 BR images were separately inspected at native size and show no numerical area or contractual unit label. Remaining layouts are form-gated. Seventeen complete building sheets retain all fourteen residential levels, duplex portions and the roof. A separate first-podium sheet is absent from this packet. Three broker 1 BR previews contain no numerical saleable area. Confirm contractual home areas and revisions with Imtiaz.
review.location: Complete brochure map 11, travel panel 12 and factsheet 2 were rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. Their conflicting Downtown estimates remain explicit. Logo-only destinations were not assigned additional times. The official named-place embed has no explicit target coordinate pair. Camera-centre values are excluded.
review.provenance: Official project/gallery and September 2026 construction pages retain dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Branded brochures and drawings retain honest Mitchell’s or Reelly mirror attribution. Public home previews retain their observed open-figure URLs. Full source bytes, notices and completed text research are preserved.

unavailable: Individual contractual saleable areas, contractual unit matching for broker previews, a separate first-podium drawing, remaining form-gated layouts, exact visitor entrance, reconciliation of the Downtown travel estimate, guaranteed home outlook and current certified site progress remain unavailable or unverified.
